name: covert-channel-gateway-v2
claim: bounded EXACT-MESSAGE RECOVERY: a uniform 32-bit secret held by U is recovered by a machine receiver with probability <= 2^-16 over the secret's lifetime. NOT a claim that coordination is impossible: a 16-bit channel carries a 1-bit command with certainty.
tests: gateway/difftest.py (300 traces vs Lean model, 0 mismatches)
gateway/test_harness.py (scripted probes only; selected encoder within model bound)
gateway/scenario/cache_probe.py (sole-view premise falsification; not full-secret recovery)

assumptions.text: GatewayModel.gateway_bound for the modelled state machine
Python gateway matches the Lean model on 300 adversarial traces (differential test), not proved

the receiver observes nothing outside the delivered view: bubblewrap harness tested selected file/network/stderr/exit-code/duration probes; shared page-cache probe demonstrates an unmediated bit (gateway/scenario/results/local-cache.json), so the sole-view premise is falsified in that setup
every receiver that can share memory with another is in one ledger lineage; the deployment must define lineages
m independent of the shared seed and receiver inputs (true in the eval design; not established for live secrets)
humans out of scope by decision (2026-10-07)
the gateway process is outside every untrusted process's address space
